column1: # The project's own names for the game's functions (docs/RECOMPILATION.md, "Annotations"), by
# offset in the 1.09 executable's image. Columns: offset, name, confidence, evidence, signature.
# Sorted by offset, one row per function; no tabs and no "*/".
# Name: Namespace::Class::method, #variant for a second copy of one method. Gnm:: is Sony's
# libGnm (linked into the game); CG:: is Dantelion2's CoreGraphics2, whose own classes use a CG
# prefix; FD4:: is FromSoftware's engine above it (the libraries of tools/recomp/label.py). FX:: is the visual effects
# (the project's guess for a family of renderers that write their vertices each frame).
# DL:: is Dantelion2's core library (its DL-prefixed classes); FMOD::, Scaleform:: and hk:: (Havok) are
# Lua:: is the script VM (Havok Script, the game's sources say, built around Lua): the name of Lua 5.0.2's
# function that holds the same messages, a guess at what the game's does. zlib:: is zlib, in two copies.
# Class names are the project's unless the evidence is "source".
# Confidence: sure (what the function does is established) or guess.
# Evidence: pm4 (a libGnm function, from the packets it writes; bloodborne-runtime's
# gpu/shim/bbport_gnm_table.inc), calls (the functions it calls and how its arguments reach them),
# source (a source path in its messages names the class).
# message (a message or label in it names the function or its class: an error text, a profiler
# label, the singletons it asserts on).
# Signature: the arguments in register order, in the project's types (empty: not worked out yet).
# Types named CG:: are described in annotations/structs.h (CG::DrawState: CgDrawState).
